shared_rules.task_polling: bounded at 180 s via time.monotonic(); TimeoutError carries the last task state
shared_rules.task_failure: non-succeeded states raise TaskFailure(state, task, result); payloads stored under error.task_state/task/task_result
shared_rules.cleanup: backend.shutdown() runs in finally inside its own try/except; failure recorded as cleanup_error, never replacing the original exception
shared_rules.record_only: no gate is asserted; adopted/first_adoption_step/variants are evidence, not acceptance

jobs.purpose: C2/C3: decide whether a SurfacePickup solve is never adopted, or adopted only after an update, for ChipZone and MechanicalSemiDiameter.

inputs.model: surface 1 radius 50, thickness 50, material N-BK7, semi_diameter 8, is_stop; one wavelength 0.5875618 um; one on-axis field
inputs.c2_single_variable: readback moment only; the submitted request is identical

close_conditions: anchors.json records closed=true after a successful disconnect.
state/close_receipt.json exists and its parsed content is stored under close_receipt.content.
A shutdown failure is recorded as cleanup_error and must not replace the original exception.
interpretation_rules: adopted=true at any step proves the native side can adopt the mode; first_adoption_step names when.
adopted=false at every step and variant supports a native limitation, but does not by itself prove one.
A failed variant never widens the contract: both items stay blocked until adoption, parameters, linkage, save/reload and close all pass.
